outputs.explanation: Panel shows a single deconvoluted native MS spectrum for PacL1 with peak masses/intensities annotated; it is a representative single measurement, not an averaged or statistically summarized result, so replicate reporting is not required.
Panel shows a single deconvoluted native MS spectrum for PacL1Δ5; no averaging, error bars, or statistics are presented, so replicate reporting is not required.

Bars show the proportion of protein bound to different numbers of Cd atoms derived from peak intensities of a single native MS spectrum per protein/ligand condition; no error bars, averaging, or statistical comparison are shown, and no replicate number is mentioned, consistent with single-measurement data.
Bars show proportion of protein bound to Zn atoms from single native MS spectra; no error bars or indication of replicate experiments are present.
Bars show proportion of protein bound to Cu atoms from single native MS spectra; no error bars or replicate information are shown or needed.
Bars show proportion of protein bound to Mn atoms from single native MS spectra; no error bars or replicate information are shown or needed.

Chemical shift perturbations per residue at increasing zinc equivalents represent a single NMR titration series (per-residue single measurements), with no error bars, averaging, or stated replicate number.
Chemical shift perturbations per residue at increasing cadmium equivalents represent a single NMR titration series with no error bars, averaging, or stated replicate number.
